extDescription.message: Write, improve and translate emails in Gmail with Google Gemini using your own API key.

instructionPlaceholder.message: e.g. decline the meeting, suggest next week (Ctrl+Enter to generate)

scopeSelection.message: Actions below apply to: selected text

scopeDraft.message: Actions below apply to: the whole draft

scopeEmpty.message: The draft is empty – actions below need text

resultLabel.message: Result (you can edit it before inserting)

privacyShort.message: Draft and thread text is sent to Google Gemini.

errInvalidKey.message: The API key is invalid or lacks permission.

errRateLimit.message: Rate limit exceeded. Try again in a moment.

errNetwork.message: No internet connection or the request timed out.

errBlocked.message: The response was blocked by Gemini safety filters. Change the instruction.

errModel.message: Model not found. Check the model name in settings.

errEmpty.message: The model returned an empty response. Try again.

errExtension.message: The extension was updated or is unavailable – reload the Gmail tab.

errEmptyDraft.message: The draft is empty – write or select some text.

errNoInstruction.message: Enter an instruction, e.g. “decline the meeting”.

errGeneric.message: An error occurred while talking to Gemini.

optPrivacy.message: Only what is needed for the action is sent to Google Gemini: your instruction, the draft or selected fragment and (optionally) earlier messages of the thread. The API key is stored locally in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and never reaches the Gmail page. Email content is subject to the Google Gemini API privacy policy.

optApiKeyHelp.message: Get a free key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey).

optLanguagesHelp.message: One language per line. Add your own, e.g. German.

optSignatureHelp.message: Added only to newly generated messages. Leave empty if you use a Gmail signature.

optSystemHelp.message: e.g. “I write as the director of company X and address people formally”.

optTemperatureHelp.message: Lower = more conservative, higher = more creative.

confirmDelete.message: Delete the API key and all settings?

testOk.message: Connection works, key and model are valid.
